author: You
description: Exposes a generic Config editor page on the Dashboard for cogs that don't ship their own dashboard integration.
install_msg: Thanks for installing DashboardBridge! Load `dashboard` first, then load this cog. A new 'DashboardBridge' entry will appear under Third Parties.
short: Generic dashboard settings pages for any cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. It only reads/writes the guild-scope Config of other loaded cogs, at the request of a user with dashboard permission to do so.
